notes.title: Patch 0.82
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

This is a small patch to fix a bug where Steam achievements for hotshot and freak difficulties weren't coming through. Sorry about that!

Your victories will still be saved even if the achievement didn't trigger previously. Now in 0.82 getting a win on hotshot or freak will trigger any relevant achievements for that difficulty retroactively. 

Thanks for playing! If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review. They help me a lot :)

Cheers,
Adam

notes.title: 'Freak' Update 0.80 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Check out the biggest update yet!

NEW CONTENT


 Added new Hotshot and Freak difficulties! Freak mode can be customized further by activating the freak stars. 5 new steam achievements have also been added for these. 

 New encounter mechanic! Meet the denizens of the desert and manage your risks and rewards. Replaces the research mechanic which has been demoted. 

 New wave generation! Get a preview of the next waves enemies for more strategic play. Waves are now procedurally generated and more dynamic. 

 New Shield Charger structure! Boosts your max shield HP. Shield expansion perk has also been buffed to boost a % of max shield also. 

 Updated Research Lab! Now has a chance to level-up when you build. Level up the perk for a better chance. This new system feels fairer and gives the player more control! 

 New Perks! New mastery-type perks boost weapon sub-types. Use the Contingency Cores perk for extra lives. 





BALANCE


 Buffed player move speed.
 Buffed briefcase upgrade damage.
 Nerfed angel kaiju satellite drop attack - replaced with bombard-style attack.
 Nerfed horizon beam range slightly so it no longer offscreens.
 Nerfed swarm launcher damage.
 Nerfed nova tower upgrade damage.
 Nerfed flamethrower piercing down slightly.
 Nerfed miniroller generally.


BUG FIX


 Fixed some bugs for players on ultrawide monitors.
 Fixed damage calculation for personal weapons.
 Fixed stat calculation for drone factories (drones are no longer affected by adjacent buffing towers).
 Drone factories no longer have 'Tower' subtype.
 Fixed some minor performance related bugs.



As always, thanks for playing! And please let me know how you're going with the game and the new updates. The feedback is very much appreciated. 

Cheers!
Adam

notes.title: 'Inventory' Update 0.72 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm super excited to deliver another large content update. 

The 'Inventory' update features a new meta progression system in the form of items that can be unlocked with kaiju cores collected in your runs. They provide permanent bonuses and a way to further customize your run. 

WHAT'S NEW IN 0.72

- Item system: unlock meta-progression items with Kaiju cores
- Critical Hits: the classic system has been introduced. More synergies coming soon. 
- Generators rework: they again provide income directly as their main function. They still boost interest by 1%

BALANCE

- Nerfed bombarder bug projectile damage
- Wave populations increased in later missions
- Wave formulation minor rebalance


BUG FIXES

- Fixed buildings getting damaged through the shield
- Fixed shield perks not being applied properly
- Engineer Max Ship HP ability now works properly
- fixed damage numbers not showing
- Minor performance improvements


Massive thanks for playing, and to everyone that has sent in bug reports or feedback. It's all very useful and appreciated. I'm always keen to hear how you are going with the game.

New difficulty settings and new perks are the priorities for the next update.

Thanks and enjoy!

-Adam

notes.title: 0.71 Steam Achievements + Balance Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this new update brings 34 new Steam achievements and crew enhancements to make runs more fun. 

WHAT'S NEW


 34 Steam achievements have been added! There will be plenty more to come.
 Repairing - all crew now have the 'Repair' stat and will repair ship HP according to that stat after each wave. This should make runs much more forgiving for non-engineer characters. The engineer's repair has also been buffed. 
 Crew Buffs - Buffed the crews starting stats (Shield HP in particular) and differentiated them a bit further.
 Broke Bonus - is now triggered when you start a wave with zero gold. 
 Added some helpful tips on rotation to the loading screen. 


Thanks for playing as always! I love to hear how you're going with the game or any feedback you may have. 

Coming in the next few updates: meta-progression, harder difficulties and 'Events' between waves!

Cheers!
-Adam

notes.title: 0.70 'Evolution' Update is now live!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Apologies for the longer-than-usual break between updates. I'm proud to present the biggest update yet.

WHAT'S NEW?

WEAPON EVOLUTIONS - Powerful new upgrades that 'evolve' a weapon or tower into a new form after it has reached max level. Evolutions change how weapons look and have powerful effects. There are 20 to discover already! The following weapons/towers can now evolve, and have 2 evolved forms each:

-Blasgun (Plasma Uzi, Rad Blaster)
-Autosword (Blink Sword, Blade Orbit)
-Briefcase (Briefcase Sentry, Portable Nuke)
-Grenade Pistol (Stun Grenades, Seeker Grenades)
-Cannon (Sniper Cannon, Punch Cannon)
-Minigun (Mini Railgun, Miniroller)
-Claymore beam (Scorching beam, Horizon beam)
-Rocket Launcher (Swarm Rockets, Guided Rocket)
-Nova Tower (Toxic Nova, Frost Nova)
-Flamethrower (Acid Sprayer, Napalmer)


MISSIONS 6 & 7 ADDED
Complete the Rookie campaign with missions 6 & 7 now added. New difficulty levels coming soon. 

ELITES
Elites monster variants are here to ruin your plans. They are marked with a blue forcefield. They spawn on a randomly selected pattern as either a tank, ranged or rapid type, and they drop gold when killed. 

NEW STATUS EFFECT: VULNERABLE
Enemies afflicted with vulnerable take additional damage. Currently applied via the Toxic Nova, Rad Blaster or the Acid Sprayer. 

BRIEFCASE UPDATE Now drops briefcases onto the map so you don't need to rely on dying so much. Still drops one when you die. 

PERFORMANCE - Improved overall performance with increased monster populations. 

BALANCE + BUG FIXES
-Rebalanced fodder waves and enemy ratios
-Decreased enemy HP on later missions
-Small nerf to minigun range
-Enemy whale guns are slower
-Shield no longer recharges after reaching zero during a wave
-Shield won't throw enemies and kaiju around

After this update, my next priority is a meta progression system to go along with some new difficulty levels/challenges. 

Thanks as always for playing! Let me know what you think about the new levels and features!

-Adam

notes.title: 'Juju Island' Update for Acid Planet is now lIve!!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I'm excited to bring to you the first content update for Acid Planet! 

MAJOR UPDATES


Missions 4 & 5, (Mangolin and the Ant Emperor) now unlockable, with a new biome of monsters.
Wave breakdown and wave bonuses added (perfect shield, broke and statue).
Generator update - earn interest on your saved gold.


MORE UPDATES AND BALANCE

Better support for colorblind players (updated minimap & warning contrast)
Key rebinding now available in-game
Increased income for all crew
Water update: now buffs income for all support structures, increases attack speed by 30%
Generator upgrades added, they buff the interest earnings cap
Fixed south-side spawning on triple vector waves + some minor other bugs


I also want to say a massive thanks to the players! I have received some incredible feedback so far. It really fires me up to keep delivering more content and updates like a maniac. Please keep it coming! 

Here are some things that will be coming in the next update (2 weeks away).

-Controller support
-Weapon evolutions
-More perks and weapons
-Loadout gadgets


-Adam
